name: codex-wakectl
description: Codex skill for inspecting, controlling, and waking app-server-backed threads.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect, control, and wake app-server-backed Codex threads.
interface.longDescription: Codex Wakectl provides workflow guidance for inspecting recent thread activity, interrupting active turns, sending immediate input, and scheduling time, goal, turn-completion, or command-based wakes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $codex-wakectl to inspect a Codex thread before choosing whether to wait, steer, interrupt, or wake it.
